text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon's run sent shockwaves 
through the crowd, making her potential 
known to all.

With her legs in great condition, she 
feels certain she can keep running 
wholeheartedly on the grand stage known as 
the Twinkle Series.

While modifying her body through further 
research, Agnes Tachyon pushed forward 
with preparations for her next goal: the 
Takarazuka Kinen.
